limitations: J measures relative gap layout and excludes common timing scale; its zero value is defined only for eligible histories.
Interior reversal may be outside the training distribution and can alter count-change RMS and gap-quantity coupling; changed-only summaries exclude no-op histories.
Checkpoint local-state geometry differs across independently trained models; compare within-checkpoint sensitivity without assigning causal quality meaning.
Train-internal association uses models already trained on these rows and selected on validation; no held-out generalization claim.
No bootstrap was run after assessability failed; missing interval is not a zero-width or nonsignificant interval.
conclusion.sensitivity: Observed frozen outputs respond to interior time and quantity permutations when inputs change. Functional response is not causal feature importance, counterfactual prediction error, time-ignoring evidence, or an encoder-defect diagnosis.

method: Independent NumPy scalar reconstruction and direct train-filtered parquet history reconstruction; torch only deserialization, canonical state bytes, and fixed randperm. Did not import analysis/features helpers or run model inference, fitting, bootstrap, or remote work.

report_spotcheck.unused_series_caveat: Unused by this diagnostic only; both frozen checkpoints already trained on these series. Any future follow-up is a separately preregistered input-support design, not an independent backbone generalization test.
